children.text: Registered construction workers can apply through any CSC center or labor office.

applicationProcess.process_md:
1. Registered construction workers can apply through any CSC center or labor office.
1. Get the application form.
1. Fill out with required details.
1. Attach the necessary documents.

children.text: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state.
It is mandatory for construction workers to be registered in any district.
Must have completed 90 days as a laborer in the board.

eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. The applicant must be a permanent resident of Chhattisgarh state.
1. It is mandatory for construction workers to be registered in any district.
1. Must have completed 90 days as a laborer in the board.

children.text: To the registered beneficiaries, medical assistance of ₹ 20,000/- or the actual expenditure incurred on the treatment, whichever is less, will be provided.

schemeContent.benefits_md: - To the registered beneficiaries, medical assistance of ₹ 20,000/- or the actual expenditure incurred on the treatment, whichever is less, will be provided.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started this scheme "Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" for labor workers.

children.text: "Chhattisgarh Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" has been started by the Chhattisgarh Government and manage/run by the Chhattisgarh, Labor Department.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: "Chhattisgarh Durghatana Mein Chikitsa Sahaayata Yojana" has been started by the Chhattisgarh Government and manage/run by the Chhattisgarh, Labor Department.
